project: Topic 04 — Agentic ML/DL for Metadata-Only TLS/SSH Threat Detection, Hunting & Response
core_principle: High detection AUC does not automatically authorize network blocking. Every action is constrained by confidence, severity, asset criticality, and environment policy (SR-06, SR-07, Section 16).

tiers.name: Observe
trigger_examples: New client fingerprint (JA4/HASSH) without corroborating malicious flow signals
Possible benign software upgrade or ECH privacy feature (CR-03)

tiers.name: Alert / Ticket
trigger_examples: Repeated suspicious connection pattern below containment threshold

tiers.name: Soft Containment
trigger_examples: High-confidence SSH brute-force / connection storm in lab/staging (T1110)
High-confidence periodic encrypted beacon in lab environment (T1573)

tiers.name: Hard Containment Proposal
trigger_examples: Verified AiTM / TLS downgrade with certificate substitution evidence (T1557)
Confirmed multi-stage malicious C2 sequence over TLS (T1573 + T1071.001)
Unauthorized SSH lateral movement across internal hosts (T1021.004)

tiers.name: Crypto Policy Remediation
trigger_examples: Deprecated TLS version or weak cipher suite negotiated (CR-01 / RFC 9846)
Weak SSH KEX / cipher / MAC algorithm negotiated (CR-04 / RFC 9142)
Expired, self-signed, or untrusted X.509 certificate chain on internal service (CR-02 / RFC 5280)
